t: The Flomasta Type 22 Convector Radiator is a robust heating solution designed for central heating systems. This white radiator, finished in traffic white (RAL 9016) with a powder-coated, high corrosion-resistant nano-zirconium coating, offers durability and a clean aesthetic, making it suitable for various applications, including offices, workshops, and residential properties. The double-panel, double-convector design ensures effective heat distribution. It comes complete with brackets, fixings, plug, and vent for straightforward installation, and features factory-fitted removable top grilles and side panels for easy maintenance.
b: Factory Fitted Removable Top Grilles & Side Panels
